The equation for the decomposition of ammonium carbonate, (NH4)2CO3, is shown.
(NH4)2CO3(s)  →  2NH3(g)  +  CO2(g)  +  H2O(l)
[Mr: (NH4)2CO3, 96]
The total volume of gas produced is 360cm3 at r.t.p.
Which mass of ammonium carbonate, (NH4)2CO3, is decomposed?
A
0.24g
B
0.48g
C
0.96g
D
1.44g
subject: Chemistry
